name: half_hitch
title: Half hitch
about: The simplest hitch: the working cord goes over the holding cord, round behind it, and out over its own standing part. One alone slips; two in a row make the double half hitch. Shown loose, from the front.

steps.caption: Bring the working cord up in front of the holding cord and over it.
Turn it to the right and take it back down behind the holding cord.
Take the end across to the left, over its own standing part, and let it hang. That is a half hitch.
